Small molecule structure elucidation from NMR spectra with generative and reasoning models.

The authors present an AI system that combines a molecular generative model (CHEFNMR2, an atomic flow-matching model) with a scientific reasoning agent to automatically determine the structure of unknown small molecules from NMR spectra. This addresses the labor-intensive, expert-dependent bottleneck in NMR-based structure elucidation, which is central to chemistry, pharmacology, and drug discovery.

MultiTargetDB: a comprehensive database of multitarget ligands for polypharmacology research and drug discovery.

MultiTargetDB is a new database that curates multitarget ligands—small molecules that bind multiple biological targets—along with chemical structures, scaffolds, drug development stages, and detailed biological annotations with measurement-level provenance. It addresses the scarcity of well-curated resources for polypharmacology research and rational multitarget drug discovery.

Integrating Multisource Target Evidence with Machine-Learning Potency Prediction for Alzheimer's Disease Drug Discovery.

The authors built an integrated platform that combines Alzheimer's disease target evidence from biological, chemical, structural, regulatory, and trial-registry sources into a single traceable resource covering 967 targets, 452,249 compounds, and 1.43 million measurements. They also show that fine-tuning the Boltz-2 affinity prediction model on target-specific data substantially improves binding-affinity prediction accuracy (Pearson r rising from 0.248 to 0.560 on a PIK3CA benchmark). The work aims to make AD target evaluation and potency modeling more reproducible and accessible.

Structure-function relationships in a square-planar Cu(ii) hybrid halometalate: experimental, DFT, molecular docking, optical, and biological studies.
